rows.note: For exceptional quality in casual speech, this is the all-purpose choice.

example.english: The beef brisket at this little shop is truly magnificent.
example.traditional: 呢間小店啲牛腩真係正。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 siu2 dim3 di1 ngau4 naam5 zan1 hai6 zing3

rows.note: Use this when praising unusually strong work, performance, or ability.

example.english: Their speech this time was truly magnificent.
example.traditional: 佢今次個演講真係好出色。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam1 ci3 go3 jin2 gong2 zan1 hai6 hou2 ceot1 sik1

rows.note: Use this for a spectacular large-scale sight or scene rather than general excellence.

example.english: The fireworks over Victoria Harbour at night were truly magnificent.
example.traditional: 維港煙花夜景真係好壯觀。
example.jyutping: wai4 gong2 jin1 faa1 je6 ging2 zan1 hai6 hou2 zong3 gun1

rows.note: Use this for an imposing, grand-looking person, building, or style.

example.english: The lobby of this new hotel is really magnificent.
example.traditional: 呢座新酒店個大堂真係好有氣派。
example.jyutping: ni1 zo6 san1 zau2 dim3 go3 daai6 tong4 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 hei3 paai3
